Both collections loaded successfully. Let me compute their spatial relationship (overlap) and areas to validate the geometry — this is a natural check when comparing two polygons.

```python
import sys, os, glob
sys.path.insert(0, "/tmp/.local/lib/python3.12/site-packages")
for libdir in glob.glob("/tmp/.local/lib/python3.12/site-packages/*.libs"):
    os.environ["LD_LIBRARY_PATH"] = libdir + ":" + os.environ.get("LD_LIBRARY_PATH", "")

import geopandas as gpd

park_gdf = gpd.GeoDataFrame.from_features(park_geojson["features"], crs="EPSG:4326")
district_gdf = gpd.GeoDataFrame.from_features(district_geojson["features"], crs="EPSG:4326")

# --- Spatial relationship in degrees (no projection, just topology) ---
park = park_gdf.geometry.iloc[0]
district = district_gdf.geometry.iloc[0]

print("Intersects:", park.intersects(district))
print("Contains (district contains park):", district.contains(park))
print("Within (park within district):", park.within(district))

inter = park.intersection(district)
print("\nIntersection type:", inter.geom_type)
print("Intersection area (deg^2):", inter.area)
print("Park area (deg^2):", park.area)
print("District area (deg^2):", district.area)
print("Overlap share of park: {:.1%}".format(inter.area / park.area))
print("Overlap share of district: {:.1%}".format(inter.area / district.area))

# --- Approximate metric areas via an equal-area projection ---
park_m = park_gdf.to_crs("EPSG:6933")
district_m = district_gdf.to_crs("EPSG:6933")
print("\n[Approx. equal-area EPSG:6933]")
print("Park area (km^2):     {:.3f}".format(park_m.geometry.area.iloc[0] / 1e6))
print("District area (km^2): {:.3f}".format(district_m.geometry.area.iloc[0] / 1e6))
```
